title: Nonparametric LLM Evaluation from Preference Data
gate_notes: C1, C2, C4, and C6 have scoped evidence contracts. C3 and C5 remain blocked because exact author-controlled finite-run realizations are unavailable. C6 uses a pinned mirror whose byte identity to the gated official source is not established. Zero of six complete paper-level claims are independently verified.

claims.summary: Finite GARS special-case identities, rankings, stationarity, and Jacobians pass with a rejecting wrong-symmetrization control.
Finite MAR EIF pathwise identity passes; omitted-IPW control is rejected.
Table 1 qualitative direction appears, but exact finite values cannot be matched without the author realization.
A-optimal KKT policy agrees with budget bisection and independent SLSQP checks.
Table 2 direction changes across clean-room routes and the exact v1 author realization is unavailable.
Full-scale 32,980-context Arena evidence and independent corruption checks pass on a pinned mirror.
